description: Open the presentation 'cell_biology_quiz.pptx'. On Slide 1, select the four graphical shapes making up the cell diagram (the large blue circle, the inner purple circle, and the two small orange ovals). Group these four shapes together into a single object. Do NOT include the four text labels on the right in the group. Once grouped, lock the group's 'Position' and 'Size' so they cannot be accidentally moved or resized. Save the result as an ODP file named 'cell_biology_locked.odp' in the '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/' directory.
